key_insight: X-AVDD distills audio-visual datasets by using cross-attention to preserve inter-modal semantics while being far more memory-efficient than prior methods.
engineering_relevance: It enables scalable training on complex models and higher samples-per-class settings, making audio-visual distillation more practical for deployment and research workflows.
method: Use cross-attention to explicitly align audio and visual modalities during synthesis.
Decouple cross-modal alignment from joint optimization to reduce memory usage.
Generate compact synthetic audio-visual sets that retain training utility across architectures.
evidence_signal: On VGGSound, X-AVDD raises top-1 accuracy from 8.2% to 24.0% at SPC=10 and from 9.8% to 26.5% at SPC=20, while also improving cross-architecture transfer and scaling to AudioCLIP with only 5.65% of the full dataset.
watch_item: Performance still depends on preserving correct cross-modal alignment, so mismatched synthesized pairs could reduce gains on harder or more diverse datasets.
